proof_body:
by
  rintro a ⟨s, hs⟩ hna
  have hsum : ∀ x : ℝ, |x| = max x 0 + max (-x) 0 := by
    intro x
    rcases le_total 0 x with h | h
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg h, max_eq_left h, max_eq_right (by linarith)]
      ring
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos h, max_eq_right h, max_eq_left (by linarith)]
      ring
  have hdiff : ∀ x : ℝ, max x 0 - x = max (-x) 0 := by
    intro x
    rcases le_total 0 x with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_right (by linarith)]
      ring
    · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_left (by linarith)]
      ring
  constructor
  · intro hp
    apply hna
    have hq : Summable (fun n => max (-a n) 0) := by
      have ht := hp.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat.sub hs
      refine ((hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat_of_nonneg (fun n => le_max_right _ _) _).2 (ht.congr fun m => ?_)).summable
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => hdiff (a n)
    exact (hp.add hq).congr fun n => (hsum (a n)).symm
  · intro hq
    apply hna
    have hp : Summable (fun n => max (a n) 0) := by
      have ht := hq.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat.add hs
      refine ((hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat_of_nonneg (fun n => le_max_right _ _) _).2 (ht.congr fun m => ?_)).summable
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      have h1 := hdiff (a n)
      linarith
    exact (hp.add hq).congr fun n => (hsum (a n)).symm
target_source: ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∃ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a i) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) → ¬ Summable (fun n => |a n|) → ¬ Summable (fun n => max (a n) 0) ∧ ¬ Summable (fun n => max (-a n) 0)
